mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) may increase cardiac arrhythmia risk and anastrozole's potential for QT prolongation; anastrozole has minimal direct CYP450 interaction with bumetanide metabolism.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, especially potassium and magnesium levels; ensure adequate supplementation; assess ECG baseline and periodically; consider alternative diuretic if cardiac risk factors present.
